summary: DEFLATE fast-path decoder (zlib-style inflate_fast equivalent). Decodes a run of literal/length and distance Huffman codes directly from the bit stream, emits literal bytes into the circular output window, and copies length-distance matches with wraparound, as long as the output window has at least 0x102 bytes free and the input has at least 0xA bits buffered. Uses the per-table node layout (bit length at node+1, flags/symbol at node+0, base at node+4) and the dword_5DA520 bit-mask table to walk the literal/length table a3 and distance table a4. Writes 'invalid distance code' / 'invalid literal/length code' into the stream error slot on malformed symbols, and persists the bit accumulator, bit count, input pointer/counters and output cursor into the inflate context a5 and stream a6 before returning 1 (block complete), 0 (ran out of window space or input), or -3 (invalid code). Called by sub_529B2C (InflateDecompressionStateMachine).

local_names.a1: literal/length bit-count index into dword_5DA520 (selects the literal mask v39)
local_names.a2: distance bit-count index into dword_5DA520 (selects the distance mask v38)
local_names.a5: inflate context (dword array): a5[7] bit count, a5[8] bit accumulator, a5[10] window start, a5[11] window end, a5[12] window capacity, a5[13] output cursor
local_names.a6: stream object: a6[0] input read pointer, a6[1] remaining input bytes, a6[2] consumed-byte counter, a6[6] error-string slot
local_names.v43: remaining input byte counter (local copy of a6[1])
local_names.j: valid bit count (local copy of a5[7])
local_names.v51: output write cursor (local copy of a5[13])

operations.description: Snapshot stream and context state into locals: input read pointer v42 = *a6, remaining input v43 = a6[1], output cursor v51 = a5[13], bit accumulator v9 = a5[8], bit count j = a5[7], window capacity v11 = a5[12].
Compute the available output-window space v40: window-end a5[11] minus cursor when the cursor is at/above capacity, otherwise capacity v11 minus cursor minus 1.
Load the two bit masks from the dword_5DA520 table: v39 = dword_5DA520[a1] (literal mask) and v38 = dword_5DA520[a2] (distance mask).
Top-up loop: while the bit count j is below 0x14, consume one input byte (--v43) and accumulate it into the bit buffer: v9 |= *v42++ << j; j += 8.

Decode a literal/length symbol: index the literal/length table by 8 * (v9 & v39) from base a3, read the node flag/len byte v47 = *node and the code bit length from node+1, then consume the code: v9 >>= len; j -= len.
Literal case (node flag byte zero): write the literal byte from node+4 into the output window (*v51++ = node[4]) and decrement the available space v40.
Run-exhaustion guard: if the window space v40 drops below 0x102 or the remaining input v43 drops below 0xA, leave the fast path and go to the state-persist/return path with result 0.

Length-code case (node flag & 0x10): compute the match length v41 = (dword base at node+4) + (v9 & dword_5DA520[flag & 0xF]) from the extra bits; top up the buffer until the bit count reaches 0xF, then decode the distance code by indexing table a4 with 8 * (v9 & v38).

Walk the distance table: for each node read the flag/len byte and code bit length from node+1, consume the code, and advance to the next node by 8 * (extra length at node+4) + 8 * (v45 & dword_5DA520[flag]) until a terminal (length-code or invalid) node is reached.

Distance-code case (distance node flag & 0x10): compute the match distance v24 = (dword base at node+4) + (v45 & dword_5DA520[flag & 0xF]), top up to the node's extra-bit count, and copy the v41-byte match from the window at (cursor - v24) into the output, wrapping through the window start a5[10] when the source precedes the window start and decrementing v40 by the match length.

Invalid-distance error: when a distance node carries the 0x40 flag, write the string 'invalid distance code' (global aInvalidDistanc, 0x005B0840) into the stream error slot a6[6] and set the return code -3.

Invalid-literal error: when a literal/length node carries the 0x40 flag, write the string 'invalid literal/length code' (global aInvalidLiteral, 0x005B0858) into the stream error slot a6[6] and set the return code -3.
End-of-block: when the final literal/length symbol carries the 0x20 flag, the block is complete and the return code is 1.

Persist state and return: store the bit accumulator into a5[8], the adjusted bit count (j - 8 * consumed) into a5[7], the output cursor into a5[13], the advanced input pointer into *a6, the remaining input count into a6[1] and the consumed-byte delta into a6[2]; return 1 (block complete), 0 (needs slow path / more input or window space) or -3 (invalid code).

clean_pseudocode: // DEFLATE fast decode (inflate_fast-style). a3 = literal/length table,
// a4 = distance table, a5 = inflate context, a6 = stream.
int InflateFastDecode(a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6) {
in = a6[0]; in_left = a6[1]; hold = a5[8]; bits = a5[7];
out = a5[13]; space = window_space(a5[11], a5[12], out);
copy_match(out, out - dist, len, window_start a5[10]);
if (*dnode & 0x40) { a6[6] = "invalid distance code"; goto err; }
if (*node & 0x40) { a6[6] = "invalid literal/length code"; goto err; }
